mentions.name: Simple Go IDE (GoLand replacement)
mentions.description: A minimal IDE for Go development built with Go and Raylib, intended to replace JetBrains GoLand by providing only the functionality the author actually uses.
mentions.problem: JetBrains GoLand provides more functionality than the author actually needs.
mentions.source_excerpt: I started working on a simple(meaning, to provide only the functionality I actually use) IDE to replace my JetBrains Goland.

evidence.value: I started working on a simple(meaning, to provide only the functionality I actually use) IDE to replace my JetBrains Goland.
